test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure from the given options would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43348d689383c18d5cca67f38f2798ffd2830da63d460fd93220026c2767cd21.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

All 3 horizontal symbols are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

Top-middle and bottom-middle symbols are interchanging their position.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

All 4 surface symbols are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

Middle symbols are replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1643e617c2d23a15c145240262633c4c9f9d038fb9f65d97f3971ed50b183182.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
